_audit_reasoning_corrected: The audit's one-line `reading` describes the VAT row as removed for containing 'tarehe 20'. The record's actual reason is FA2026 s.95's replacement of VAT Act s.71(5). The arm-3 classifier scored BODIES against figure patterns and never read the quarantine REASONS, so its verdicts are right about the rows and unreliable about WHY each was removed.

restorations.why_correct: The 20th is attached to the RETURN ('return yako ya VAT, inayowasilishwa kufikia tarehe 20'), which is correct. The remittance sentence carries NO date, so the row cannot assert the deadline FA2026 s.95 superseded. Incomplete, not wrong.
quarantine_reason_as_written: asserts VAT withholding is remitted/paid to TRA by the 20th of the following month. Finance Act 2026 s.95, in force 1 July 2026, repealed and replaced VAT Act s.71(5): the deadline is now within 10 days after the end of the tax period. The 20th was correct under Finance Act 2025's original s.71(5) text ("at the time when the value added tax return is due to be filed") but is no longer correct going forward. Re-verified 2026-09-01 by direct comparison of both Finance Acts' verbatim text.
restorations.residual_risk_recorded_not_acted_on: The row names no remittance deadline, so a reader could infer the 20th covers it by adjacency. That is an inference about what a correct row might imply, and removing a correct row on such an inference is the failure mode this restoration exists to repair. The real fix is a POSITIVE row teaching FA2026 s.95's 10 days after the end of the tax period -- an addition, not a deletion. Tracked as an A2 content gap.
